title: Stabilization of small organic molecules on V2C and V2CO2 MXenes: first-principles insights into the performance of van der Waals functionals and the effect of oxygen vacancies
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,301-311
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06676F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Thong Nguyen-Minh Le, Thong Le Minh Pham, Thang Bach Phan, Yoshiyuki Kawazoe
Multiple phases of V2CTx show high selectivities and affinities towards small organic molecules, i.e., CH4, CO2, and H2O. Controlling the present contents of terminal groups is the key to the separation applications.
